cases.name: defaults-pi30-pd45-pn25
cases.note: Bayesian log-odds combine: logW_IMBH=log10(p_imbh/total)+sumR+sumS, logW_DC=log10(p_dc/total)+sumS, logW_NULL=log10(p_null/total) where sumR/sumS are the summed per-evidence log10 Bayes-factor sliders (defaults: kinematics r1.0 s2.0, pulsar r-0.8 s1.5, propmotion r0.4 s1.5, accretion r-0.3 s0.4, nbody r0.2 s1.2, microlensing r0 s0 -> sumR=0.5, sumS=6.6); normalize via softmax in log-space. Independently reimplemented and cross-checked exactly against the page formula in board session FW-5.
